title: 第14章 西边捡来的项西(14)
slug: 格格不入全本免费-格格不入最新章节列表
content_zh:
本来只打算唱一首，但一个回不了家也没人来医院陪着的大叔让他再唱一首，他就又唱了。
想到这个大叔，他突然想到了展宏图他爸……
项西和馒头在网吧泡了两天了，过年新开的网吧，网费充一百送一百。
网吧里的人比平时的多了不少，那些有学上的不良少年一放假都上网吧来跟他们这些没上学的不良少年抢机器来了。
“我饿了。”项西叼着烟说。
“泡面？”馒头看了他一眼，他知道项西不爱吃那玩意，于是又补了一句，“现在也买不到别的东西吃啊。”
“超市有牛肉丸，”项西扔了鼠标站起来，“你吃吗？”
“吃！”馒头赶紧点头，想想又说，“要走挺远呢，开我的车过去吧。”
“不用，你那车还没你蹦得快呢，”项西说，“我顺便透透气。”
出了网吧大门项西才发现又下雪了，今年过年这雪下得还真是够本，他身上就穿了件旧的羽绒服，里面一件薄毛衣，有点儿扛不住。
想回网吧里把馒头的衣服扒一件下来，又懒得再回头上楼了，最后他只是拉了拉衣领，抱着胳膊小步蹦着到了街上。
对街有个人正慢吞吞地往街这边走过来，项西扫了一眼就转开了头，就觉得大冷天看到温暖的网吧大门就在前方了居然还能这么镇定地一步步走过去，挺神奇的，换了他早扑着进去了。
刚往遥远的超市那边走了两步，项西就听到身后传来了脚步声，跑得还挺急。
这脚步声不太正常，他回过头看了一眼，出于长期混战中自保的习惯，他回头时是弓着背的，这样可以保证在身后有人偷袭时不至于被人直接打中后脑勺和肩。
不过这次这个动作没能帮到他。
他胳膊上被什么东西砸了一下。
项西连对方的脸长什么样都没仔细看，扭头拔腿就跑。
他边跑边觉得今天为了打折的网费跑这儿来上网很失策，想想又觉得这人也真够神奇的，又不是白天，灯光也不怎么明媚，他出来的时候缩得跟做贼似的，居然还能被人追过来，实在是想不通。
最后他把这一切都归结为自己的发型，今天刚去弄的，让发型师把两边长长了的头发又给推了推，中间的还喷了点儿发胶定型。
结果因为太帅要被人揍了。

在项西漫长的跑步逃命生涯中，能像现在身后这位这样追了五分钟还没放弃并且居然没掉队的人实属少见。
饿着肚子这么狂奔，项西已经开始觉得累了，何况程大夫还说过，他不能老这么跑，腿这才刚拆了石膏没几天……
他都想回头问问他：“你是不是爱上我了，追个没完没了了还！”
身后大概是驴脸的人，或者是急于在驴脸跟前立功领赏的人，总之就是执著地甩着腿追。
就在项西实在不想跑了，打算回头跟这人干一架，大不了再断一次腿的时候，前方一辆停在路边临时停车位上的黑色车子跃入他的视线。
这车熟悉，车牌……没错！
再看到一边打着电话一边拉开了车门准备上去的程博衍时，项西感觉自己得救了。
他冲过去拉开了副驾的门，跟程博衍几乎同时坐到了车里，再回手嘭的一声把门给关上了。
程博衍显然被吓了一跳，手还握着驾驶室那边的门，瞪着他都忘了关车门。
“关门关门，”项西一连串地喊，边喊边回头看，“开车开车开车！”
“你又被债主追？”程博衍关上了车门，锁上了。
“什么债主！我就上个网吧，出来就碰上了！”项西催着他，“快开车！”
“没在医院照顾你爸？”程博衍也回头看着后面。
“我什么爸！我哪儿来的爸……”项西说了一半停下了，转过头看着程博衍。
程博衍盯着他看了几秒钟，手指在方向盘上轻轻敲了敲：“下去。”
项西觉得自己今天要走背字。
后面的人已经追了过来，手上拿着的半截棍子都能看清了，程博衍还平静地坐在驾驶座上看着他。
“你看不到人吗！”项西急了，看来程博衍是不打算开车，也不打算帮他了，他得自己想办法。
程博衍的态度让他有些失望，但并没打击到他，这是正常反应，换了谁都是这样，不奇怪。
项西决定下车，既然程博衍不打算帮他，他就得马上下车，要不那人追过来把车再弄坏了他赔不起。

content_en:
Originally he only planned to sing one song, but an uncle who could not go home and had no one to come to the hospital with him asked him to sing another song, so he sang again.
Thinking of this uncle, he suddenly thought of Zhan Hongtu's father...
Xiang west and Mantou have been hanging out in the Internet cafe for two days. The newly opened Internet cafe during the Chinese New Year offers a 100-yuan bonus when you recharge the Internet fee.
There were a lot more people in the Internet cafe than usual. Those delinquent teenagers who were in school came to the Internet cafe during the holidays to compete with these delinquent teenagers who were not in school to grab the machines.
"I'm hungry." Xiang west said while holding a cigarette.
"Instant noodles?" Mantou glanced at him. He knew that Xiang west didn't like eating that stuff, so he added, "I can't buy anything else to eat now."
"There are beef balls in the supermarket," Xiang west threw the mouse and stood up, "Do you want to eat them?"
"Eat!" Steamed Bun nodded quickly, then thought about it and said, "It's a long way to go. Let's drive there in my car."
"No, your car can't jump as fast as you," Xiang west said, "I just wanted to take a breather."
Xiang Xi found out that it was snowing again when he left the Internet cafe. It snowed really hard during the Chinese New Year this year. He was wearing an old down jacket with a thin sweater underneath, which was a bit unbearable.
He wanted to go back to the Internet cafe and take off his clothes, but he was too lazy to go back upstairs. In the end, he just pulled his collar, crossed his arms and skipped to the street.
There was a person walking slowly towards the street across the street. Xiang Xi glanced at it and turned his head away. He felt that it was a cold day and he could see the warm door of the Internet cafe in front of him. It was amazing that he could walk over so calmly step by step. Otherwise, he would have rushed in.
Just after taking two steps towards the distant supermarket, Xiang west heard footsteps coming from behind, and he was running quite fast.
The sound of footsteps was unusual. He turned around and glanced back. Out of the habit of protecting himself in long-term melees, he hunched his back when he looked back. This would ensure that he would not be hit directly in the back of the head and shoulder if someone attacked behind him.
But this time the action failed to help him.
Something hit him on the arm.
Xiang west didn't even look carefully at what the other person's face looked like, so he turned around and ran away.
As he ran, he felt that it was a mistake to come here to surf the Internet today for the discounted Internet fee. After thinking about it, he felt that this person was really magical. It was not daytime and the light was not very bright. When he came out, he shrunk like a thief. It was really unfathomable that he could be chased by someone.
In the end, he attributed it all to his hair style. He just got it done today and asked the hairstylist to push back the hair that had grown longer on both sides, and sprayed some hairspray on the middle hair to set it.
As a result, he was beaten because he was too handsome.
In Xiang west's long career of running for his life, it is rare to find a person like the one behind him who did not give up after chasing for five minutes and did not fall behind.
Xiang west was already starting to feel tired from running around like this on an empty stomach. Besides, Doctor Cheng also said that he couldn't keep running like this. The cast on his leg had just been removed for a few days...
He even wanted to turn around and ask him: "Are you in love with me and chasing me endlessly?"
The person behind him was probably a donkey-faced person, or someone who was eager to perform meritorious service and receive a reward in front of the donkey-faced person. In short, he was chasing after him with his legs swinging persistently.
Just when Xiang Xi really didn't want to run away anymore and was planning to turn around and fight with this man, or risk breaking his leg again, a black car parked in a temporary parking space on the roadside jumped into his sight.
This car is familiar, the license plate...that's right!
When he saw Cheng Boyan who was talking on the phone and opening the car door to get in, Xiang west felt that he had been saved.
He rushed over and opened the passenger door. He and Cheng Boyan got into the car almost at the same time, and then closed the door with a bang.
Cheng Boyan was obviously taken aback. His hand was still holding the door of the cab, and he forgot to close the door while staring at him.
"Close the door, close the door," Xiang west shouted in succession, looking back while shouting, "Drive, drive, drive!"
"You are in debt againMain pursuit? "Cheng Boyan closed the car door and locked it.
"What creditor! I went to an Internet cafe and met him right after I came out! Xiang west urged him, "Drive quickly!" "
"Not taking care of your dad in the hospital? "Cheng Boyan also looked back.
"Who am I, dad! Where did my dad come from..." Xiang west stopped mid-sentence and turned to look at Cheng Boyan.
Cheng Boyan stared at him for a few seconds, then tapped his fingers on the steering wheel: "Get off. "
Xiang west felt that he had to memorize Chinese characters today.
The person behind him had already chased after him, and he could clearly see half of the stick in his hand. Cheng Boyan was still sitting calmly in the driver's seat looking at him.
"Can't you see anyone? "Xiang west was anxious. It seemed that Cheng Boyan was not going to drive or help him. He had to find a way by himself.
Cheng Boyan's attitude made him a little disappointed, but it didn't hit him. This was a normal reaction. It happened to everyone, so it wasn't surprising.
Xiang west decided to get out of the car. Since Cheng Boyan was not going to help him, he had to get out of the car immediately, otherwise he would not be able to afford the compensation if the man chased him and damaged the car again.
